text:
Sam R (SE): opening MerchantCo BYO-HSM POC thread. Req: BYO HSM for envelope keys + runtime unwraps, rotation <=12h, and dry-run for 2-person custody. Also asked for delta pricing and a sample SOW clause for liability.
Hannah G (AE): pricing question: do we meter HSM wrap/unwrap as 'key_ops' separate from token billing? They want predictable monthly cap for high throughput.
Sam R (SE): yes — we bill wrap/unwrap as key_ops. Proposal: monthly proxy fee + per-op meter, with optional block credits for QPS bursts. I'll draft two pricing tiers (standard/dedicated).
Vik P (Security): SQ asks: provide vendor attestation (FIPS level), SOC2 artifacts, diagram proving key material never leaves customer HSM, and a written runbook for rotation/dry-run. They want audit streaming into their Splunk instance.
Ravi M (SRE): attestation + logs: we can provide vendor attestation PDF and JSON audit events. Latency note: unwrap ~4-25ms plus proxy; include circuit-breaker behavior (fail-open vs fail-closed) in SOW. We can forward events to their HTTP collector; sample schema: {timestamp,event_type,key_id,result}.
Olive (Deal Ops): quote needs two flavors: 1) managed key-proxy in customer VPC (we operate proxy) and 2) fully private deployment (we ship package). Add PS hours for ceremony facilitation (6h) and optional insurance rider coordination (customer asked about crypto-insurance impact).
Hannah G (AE): legal/indemnity: customer asked for a limited liability carve-out for BYOK. Legal will push standard language: customer retains custody and risk. Can we offer a paid insurance facilitation service?
Vik P (Security): we don't provide insurance, but we can provide artifacts to help them buy crypto-insurance (attestation, rotation logs, SOC2). Also confirm we support mutual-TLS pinning to proxy and HSM vendor attestations.
Sam R (SE): small config snippet to show binding flow:
```
redwoodctl bind --byo --key-arn arn:hsm:region:acct:key/kk-42 \
  --proxy https://proxy.merchantco.example --mtls /etc/mtls.pem
```
Hannah G (AE): acceptance criteria for POC: 1) end-to-end encrypt/decrypt using their KEK, 2) rotation with zero dropped requests, 3) 95p gen latency <=180ms, 4) audit stream to Splunk.
Olive (Deal Ops): I'll prepare the two-variant quote + PS lines and add a block for optional insurance facilitation. Will circulate draft SOW in 24h.
redwood-bot: uploaded artifact: merchantco/poc-attestation-collection.zip
Sam R (SE): thanks — looping legal and finance, will follow up with perf numbers and per-op price bands. :thumbsup:
